name: How do I choose a contractor for a second-story addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for a second-story addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for a second-story addition, look for experience with similar projects, proper licensing and insurance, and strong references. Verify their portfolio and ask for a detailed proposal that outlines the scope of work, timeline, and cost. It's also important to feel comfortable with their communication style and to ensure they understand your vision. A reliable contractor will guide you through the entire complex process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on experience, licensing, insurance, references, and a detailed proposal for your second-story addition.
